target_customer: Small and mid sized US businesses (trucking, contractors, restaurants and bars, lawn care) buying commercial insurance
problem: Commercial insurance placement is slow, taking over a month for a policy, because brokers spend most of their time on operational paperwork.
business_model: Insurance brokerage earning carrier commissions, with AI automating submissions, quoting and certificates; operates through Casey Labs Insurance Services LLC

founders.name: Maximilian Thoelen
founders.background_notes: Per YC page. Education not listed. Role title taken as CEO is not stated, so see notes.

competitors.name: Harper
competitors.what: AI native commercial insurance brokerage, a YC company
competitors.traction_then: Per its YC launch page, over $6M annualized premiums written across 35 states

technical_complexity.rationale: Ingesting client data and carrier forms to prepare submissions needs document extraction and carrier integrations, plus insurance licensing and operations.

defensibility.rationale: Broker licensing is a modest barrier, but several funded AI brokerages pursue the same wedge and carrier access is shared.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: AI brokerages and brokerage workflow tools raised funds through 2025 and 2026 (Harper, Delegance, Anzen, Fulcrum). No evidence found of Casey being bought or copied.

market_need_then: Commercial placement times of over a month are cited by the company, and AI centered insurtechs took most insurtech funding in Q3 2025 per an industry article, indicating investor and customer demand.

branding.domain_note: Brokerage site uses caseyinsure.com; an alternate meetcasey.ai domain also appeared in sources.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain direct language, tagline Business insurance that has your back, headers ending in periods

branding.brand_signature: Business insurance that has your back

brand_strength.rationale: A friendly human name but very common, and no press about the brand was found.

outcome_analysis: Casey is an early stage Fall 2025 company whose three founders come from the Swiss insurtech grape insurance, a clear domain fit. Public funding information is not available, and similar AI brokerages such as Harper raised far more, so the outcome is still open and competitive pressure is high.
notes: Funding not recorded as rounds: only aggregators report figures and they conflict (CB Insights $500K convertible note, Caplight seed on 2025-09-01 with $1.5M, another $2.5M seed). The founder role for Thoelen is not stated by the YC page, so role is a placeholder. Harper source date is only the year. YC page lists three founders while the directory lists team size 5.
